title: Frontend / CLI / Protocol Surface Test Strategy v1

tests.test_name: Frontend intent gating rejects unapproved mutation intents
tests.what_it_catches: Cockpit sends a mutation intent without approval; backend must reject with 403 and log refusal event

tests.test_name: Widget evidence links resolve to valid receipt SHA256
tests.what_it_catches: Widget panels display evidence links that reference nonexistent receipts or malformed SHA256 values

tests.test_name: XSS injection through projection fields is neutralized
tests.what_it_catches: Malicious HTML/JS injected into projection data fields renders in cockpit; CSP headers missing or permissive

tests.test_name: Stale projection data does not show phantom worktrees
tests.what_it_catches: Projection snapshot from a deleted worktree lingers in cockpit after worktree GC; backend sends stale state

tests.test_name: Status indicators reflect all 9 defined states correctly
tests.what_it_catches: Status indicator enum mismatches between backend projection and frontend rendering; missing states cause display errors

tests.test_name: Trust spine gating prevents frontend from bypassing approval flow
tests.what_it_catches: Frontend sends a mutation command with forged approval token; trust spine rejects and emits telemetry event

tests.test_name: Postgres degraded mode shows warning indicators in cockpit
tests.what_it_catches: Postgres connection drops; cockpit continues with degraded projection but shows clear warning chips

tests.test_name: Hosted team indicators display correct tenant and RBAC info
tests.what_it_catches: Multi-tenant cockpit shows wrong tenant context or exposes cross-tenant projection data

tests.test_name: CLI dry-run mode produces structured JSON output by default
tests.what_it_catches: CLI emits unstructured text instead of JSON in dry-run mode; downstream tooling breaks

tests.test_name: CLI JSON schema matches documented contract
tests.what_it_catches: CLI output JSON does not validate against its published schema; schema drift undetected

tests.test_name: CLI exit codes follow documented semantic contract
tests.what_it_catches: CLI exits with 0 on partial failure or wrong exit code for permission denial; scripts misinterpret results

tests.test_name: CLI never emits Markdown as structured evidence output
tests.what_it_catches: CLI outputs markdown report instead of JSONL/JSON evidence artifact; violates evidence doctrine

tests.test_name: Scripts governance gating prevents CLI bypass of cockpit approval
tests.what_it_catches: A script invokes mutation via CLI while cockpit approval is pending; governance gate rejects

tests.test_name: Dry-run mode exercises all CLI code paths without side effects
tests.what_it_catches: Dry-run flag skipped; side-effecting code runs during dry-run; dry-run coverage gaps

tests.test_name: MCP tool descriptor integrity enforced against tampered manifests
tests.what_it_catches: MCP server sends a tampered tool descriptor; descriptor integrity check rejects and logs

tests.test_name: MCP tool poisoning via overlapping names is prevented
tests.what_it_catches: Two MCP servers expose tools with the same name; namespace collision poisons tool dispatch

tests.test_name: MCP roots boundary rejects file access outside declared roots
tests.what_it_catches: MCP tool accesses a file path outside declared roots; boundary enforcement rejects

tests.test_name: MCP mutation tools are gated behind approval receipt requirement
tests.what_it_catches: MCP host invokes a mutation tool without a valid approval receipt; gate blocks execution

tests.test_name: MCP content-light output enforces no secret leakage in tool responses
tests.what_it_catches: MCP tool response inadvertently includes raw file contents with secrets; content-light scanner catches and redacts

tests.test_name: MCP per-user authorization scopes tool access correctly
tests.what_it_catches: User A's MCP session accesses tools scoped to User B; per-user auth boundary fails

tests.test_name: ACP message schema rejection for malformed session requests
tests.what_it_catches: ACP client sends malformed JSON that passes transport parsing but violates message schema; server rejects with structured error

tests.test_name: ACP mission scope enforcement rejects out-of-scope tool calls
tests.what_it_catches: ACP session requests a tool outside its declared mission scope; scope enforcement rejects

tests.test_name: ACP session cancellation and timeout release resources
tests.what_it_catches: ACP session hangs after cancel; tool leases leak; timeout does not trigger cleanup

tests.test_name: ACP receipt persistence survives server restart
tests.what_it_catches: ACP-produced receipts are lost on server restart; WAL durability guarantees broken

tests.test_name: A2A malicious agent card causes safe rejection
tests.what_it_catches: Attacker publishes an agent card with forged capabilities or spoofed trust tier; A2A client rejects

tests.test_name: A2A scope enforcement prevents remote agent from escalating privileges
tests.what_it_catches: Remote A2A agent requests a tool tier above its declared trust level; scope enforcement rejects

tests.test_name: A2A trust tier downgrade on suspicious behavior
tests.what_it_catches: Remote agent exhibits anomalous request patterns; trust tier dynamically downgraded; further requests blocked

tests.test_name: A2A timeout and budget enforcement caps remote agent consumption
tests.what_it_catches: Remote A2A agent exceeds allocated token budget or time budget; enforcement caps and reports

tests.test_name: MCP to GitHub bypass is blocked by composition guard
tests.what_it_catches: Agent uses MCP tool chain to reach GitHub mutation API without cockpit approval; composition guard detects cross-surface escalation

tests.test_name: A2A to GitHub bypass is blocked by composition guard
tests.what_it_catches: Remote A2A agent chains through local MCP server to reach GitHub mutation; cross-surface check rejects

tests.test_name: Hosted team debug endpoint does not leak production secrets
tests.what_it_catches: Debug endpoint in hosted team mode exposes API keys, env vars, or session tokens; content-light filter catches

tests.test_name: Frontend to MCP bypass is blocked by governance spine
tests.what_it_catches: Frontend injects a WebSocket message that triggers MCP mutation without approval; governance spine intercepts

tests.test_name: ACP to subagent bypass blocked by mission scope composition guard
tests.what_it_catches: ACP session spawns subagent with escalated tool permissions; composition guard enforces parent scope on subagent

tests.test_name: SSH to local bypass blocked by future supervisor wrapping
tests.what_it_catches: SSH channel provides remote mutation access that bypasses local governance; future supervisor wrapping planned

tests.test_name: Static docs site does not leak internal-only content
tests.what_it_catches: Static doc renderer includes internal-only JSON artifacts in public site; public/private split fails
